headline: Marketing Manager | Insurance & Financial Services | Strategic Growth & Brand Leadership
summary: Results-driven Marketing Manager with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in financial services and digital growth. Proven expertise in developing comprehensive marketing strategies, managing multi-channel campaigns across digital and traditional platforms, and leading cross-functional teams to maximize ROI. Skilled in brand management, market research, and budget optimization, with a strong track record of driving customer acquisition and engagement in competitive markets. Adept at leveraging analytics, CRM tools, and marketing automation to deliver data-driven insights and executive-level reporting.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed and executed comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with corporate objectives, managing annual budgets and ensuring long-term business growth in financial markets.
Led integrated marketing campaigns across digital (Google/Meta Ads) and traditional platforms, driving significant increases in lead generation and conversion rates.
Managed brand portfolio and positioning, ensuring consistent messaging and visibility across MENA, EU, and Asian markets.
Directed market research initiatives to identify new business opportunities and monitor competitor activities, resulting in strategic adjustments that improved market share.
Analyzed marketing performance using KPIs (ROAS, ROA, CAC), providing detailed ROI reports and strategic insights to senior management.
Collaborated with sales, product, and compliance departments to align marketing efforts with business goals and regulatory requirements.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Oversaw user growth and engagement strategies, implementing multi-channel campaigns that expanded the customer base across diverse demographics.
Managed content development and brand storytelling, creating compelling narratives that resonated with target audiences and enhanced brand loyalty.
Utilized CRM tools and marketing automation platforms to streamline lead nurturing processes and improve customer retention.
Led a sub-team of digital marketing and content specialists, providing mentorship and direction to achieve campaign targets.
Conducted A/B testing and performance analysis to optimize ad spend and improve campaign efficiency, achieving a 20% reduction in cost per acquisition.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Marketing Manager position at EgyBell. With a robust background in financial services marketing and a proven track record of driving growth through strategic, data-driven campaigns, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your brand's success. My experience in managing multi-channel initiatives, leading cross-functional teams, and optimizing marketing budgets aligns perfectly with EgyBell's objectives. I am eager to bring my expertise in brand management and market analysis to your team in Mohandeseen, helping to elevate EgyBell's market presence and customer engagement.

screening.q: Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing or Business Administration?
screening.a: Yes, I hold a Bachelor of Business Administration.

screening.q: How many years of experience do you have in marketing, and how many in a managerial role?
screening.a: I have over 12 years of experience in marketing, with 4-5 years in managerial roles.

screening.q: Do you have experience in the insurance or financial services industry?
screening.a: Yes, I have extensive experience in financial markets, Forex, and fintech, which is highly transferable to the insurance sector.

screening.q: Are you proficient in English and Arabic?
screening.a: Yes, I have native Arabic and professional working proficiency in English.

screening.q: Are you comfortable working in Mohandeseen?
screening.a: Yes, I am located in Cairo and am comfortable working in Mohandeseen.
